revision.description: Free-form suite revision. Bump it whenever a case or calibration file changes; old logs record the revision they were scored against.

status.description: A suite is `approved` only when a Salt maintainer has approved every non-draft case in it.

packages.description: Salt package version ranges the cases were written against, e.g. {"@salt-ds/core": "1.x"}.

docs_revision.description: Commit or release of the Salt documentation the references were reviewed against.

canary.description: Unique string embedded in every case. If a model reproduces it unprompted, the suite has leaked into training data.

judge_thresholds.description: Limits `salt-eval calibrate` enforces against maintainer-labelled calibration examples.
